We need to produce a test class that tests the static debug method. Since debug just logs a debug message using logger.debug with placeholders. We need to verify that logger.debug is called with correct arguments. Use Mockito to mock Logger. Since method is static, we can call BaseJsonValidator.debug(logger, node, rootNode, instanceLocation). Provide JsonNode mocks (or actual nodes). Use mock(JsonNode.class). For JsonNodePath also mock or create new instance. PathType default maybe needed; we can instantiate JsonNodePath with PathType.DEFAULT? PathType enum not provided; but we can use new JsonNodePath(PathType.DEFAULT) if accessible. However PathType may be package-private. Simpler: mock(JsonNodePath.class). Provide logger mock. Then verify logger.debug called with format string "validate( {}, {}, {})" and the three arguments. However SLF4J Logger debug method overloaded: debug(String format, Object arg1, Object arg2, Object arg3). So we can verify logger.debug(eq("validate( {}, {}, {})"), same(node), same(rootNode), same(instanceLocation)). Use Mockito.verify.
